# Spec Delta

## Purpose

Restricts the AG web app to people who received the AG's access code (by the convocation email or a QR code in the room), keeps the Bureau's tools behind a separate password, and lets the media proxy check access to the interpretation feed.

## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Access code per AG
Each AG SHALL have one access code of 6 to 8 characters drawn from an alphabet without ambiguous characters (no 0/O, 1/l/I), generated by the app and changeable by the Bureau before the AG opens.

#### Scenario: Code generated for a new AG
- **WHEN** the Bureau creates an AG
- **THEN** an access code is generated and shown with the participant link and a printable QR code of that link

### Requirement: Access by link
A request carrying a valid code in the `c` query parameter SHALL receive a participant access cookie and be redirected to the same URL without the code.

#### Scenario: Opening the convocation link
- **WHEN** a person opens `https://<host>/?c=<valid code>`
- **THEN** the response sets the participant access cookie and redirects to `https://<host>/`
- **AND** the address bar no longer shows the code

#### Scenario: Link with an invalid code
- **WHEN** a person opens the app with a wrong or expired code
- **THEN** no cookie is set and the code entry page is shown with a neutral message

### Requirement: Typed code fallback
A person without a valid cookie SHALL see only a code entry page explaining that the link from the convocation is needed, where they can type the code; a valid code grants the same cookie as the link.

#### Scenario: Typing the code
- **WHEN** a person without a cookie types the valid code, in any letter case
- **THEN** they get the participant access cookie and land on the participant page

#### Scenario: Visitor without a code
- **WHEN** a client without a cookie requests any participant page or API
- **THEN** page requests show the code entry page and API requests return 401, without revealing any AG content

### Requirement: Attempt rate limiting
Code checks SHALL be rate-limited per client IP, allowing at most 10 failed attempts per 10 minutes.

#### Scenario: Repeated wrong codes
- **WHEN** a client submits an 11th wrong code within 10 minutes
- **THEN** the attempt is rejected with a "too many attempts" message without checking the code

### Requirement: Access cookie scope and lifetime
The participant access cookie SHALL be HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, bound to the AG it was issued for, and SHALL stop granting access when that AG's code is changed or its data deleted.

#### Scenario: Code changed by the Bureau
- **WHEN** the Bureau changes the access code
- **THEN** cookies issued with the old code no longer grant access

### Requirement: No referrer leakage
All app responses SHALL send `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`.

#### Scenario: Embedded YouTube player
- **WHEN** the participant page loads the YouTube player
- **THEN** the request to YouTube carries no Referer header containing the app's URL

### Requirement: Separate Bureau authentication
Bureau pages and APIs SHALL require a Bureau session obtained with the Bureau password; the participant access code or cookie SHALL NOT grant Bureau access.

#### Scenario: Participant tries the dashboard
- **WHEN** a person with only a participant cookie opens the Bureau dashboard
- **THEN** they are sent to the Bureau login page

#### Scenario: Bureau login
- **WHEN** a Bureau member enters the correct Bureau password and a display name
- **THEN** they get a Bureau session, and their display name is recorded on their moderation actions

### Requirement: Media access check endpoint
The app SHALL expose an internal endpoint that returns 200 when the forwarded request carries a valid participant cookie or Bureau session, and 401 otherwise, for use by the reverse proxy in front of the interpretation feed.

#### Scenario: Proxy check with a valid cookie
- **WHEN** the proxy forwards a request carrying a valid participant cookie to the check endpoint
- **THEN** the endpoint responds 200

#### Scenario: Proxy check without a cookie
- **WHEN** the proxy forwards a request with no valid cookie or session
- **THEN** the endpoint responds 401
